p.PORTABLE-CONTRACT: This installed contract governs a parent commissioning a Codex execution, review or consultation worker. The parent owns architecture, public semantics, unresolved ambiguity, destructive decisions, routing, integration, staging, commits and acceptance. A worker executes or advises and never accepts its own work. Host authorization and safety rules still bind the parent before delegation. System and harness instructions retain their authority; quiet mode controls discovered project documents and does not disable those instructions.

p.BOUNDED-OUTCOME: A bounded task has one observable outcome; closed named standing/source inputs and write scope; narrow meaningful oracles including failure cases where material; dependency and stop conditions; a time/resource budget; a durable report path and an accepting parent. Width is semantic responsibility, not lines of code or token budget. A hard requirement is never removed merely to manufacture a smaller contract.

p.ROUTING: Delegate execution when independent verification is cheaper than generation. Announce the selected harness and bounded outcome. Parent review remains mandatory even when an independent worker reviews the result. Parallelize disjoint write sets only; retain one live writer for each intersecting scope. Do not commission duplicate workers for the same outcome.

p.PARENT-LOADS-RULES: The parent loads the governing host rules itself and chooses the exact standing files that bind this task. It names each file explicitly, including any needed nested-directory rules. Workers do not infer a relevant boot lane, load broad project plans, claim central stewardship or consult custody/handoffs.

p.QUIET-FIRST-LINE: The packet and its short pointer start on their first line with the exact marker ##subagent-quiet-clause. The worker reads only the named standing rules and source inputs, plus its packet and explicitly named correction. Do not run the full host boot or follow broad includes from a named rule. The packet must specify the relevant governing subset instead.

p.PACKET-DEFECT: If a required rule, input, dependency or scope decision is absent, report the exact packet defect. The parent amends the packet before any dependent worker action. Workers do not discover omitted instructions by loading the full boot lane or silently broaden their scope.

p.CLI-SUPPRESSION: Unattended CLI exec uses --strict-config --ignore-user-config and -c project_doc_max_bytes=0 so automatic project-document discovery cannot precede the explicit packet. The marker alone cannot stop a harness that already loaded AGENTS.md. The launcher rejects exec profile switches (-p) and CLI configuration overrides of project_doc_max_bytes or authentication storage. Explicit model/effort overrides remain requests. These flags are CLI-specific. For native workers the parent must explicitly pass the packet and confirm host boot-suppression support; this package does not guarantee native harness behavior.

p.BOUNDARY-KIND: Quiet mode is an instruction/context boundary, not a filesystem read sandbox. Named inputs are a cooperative reading contract. CLI sandbox policy separately limits operations and writes; it does not prove that an unnamed readable file is inaccessible. Report observed scope breaches plainly.

p.INSTALL-DEPLOY: Declare tool:org.vibevm.world/codex-subagents@1.1.0 and materialise with ordinary vibe install. Deploy the resolved slot with an explicit posix or windows profile. No default profile is inferred. The deploy engine publishes receipt-owned launchers under <settings-root>/opt/bin, default ~/.vibe/opt/bin, and owns drift, recovery and undeploy. Never replace it with install-hook copying. PATH is not modified.

p.ENTRYPOINTS: The POSIX launcher is codex-worker; Windows provides codex-worker.ps1 and the convenience shim codex-worker.cmd. Commands are login [login options], status, interactive [CLI options], and exec [exec options/prompt or - for stdin]. There is no daemon, scheduler, implicit retry, shared parent conversation or worker acceptance logic.

p.ISOLATED-HOME: CODEX_WORKER_HOME is required and must be an explicit absolute isolated state directory; never default to ordinary ~/.codex. CODEX_WORKER_BIN optionally selects an installed Codex executable. CODEX_WORKER_MODEL defaults to gpt-6.1-sol and CODEX_WORKER_EFFORT to medium. Authenticate through login into file-based ChatGPT auth in this isolated home. status checks login state, not entitlement or quota.

p.CHILD-ENV: Clear inherited CODEX_ and OPENAI_ authentication, routing and session environment before constructing the child environment from launcher inputs. Preserve TLS CA configuration. Set the child CODEX_HOME to the explicit isolated home and force file credential storage. Do not forward a parent thread/session identifier or inherited API credential. Never inspect, print, hash or copy credential values into packets, reports or logs.

p.ARGS-EXIT: POSIX preserves cwd and exact argument boundaries; all launchers return the real child exit. PowerShell restores its temporary process environment. Windows PowerShell 5.1 and the CMD shim may reparse native arguments, losing empty arguments or unusual quoting. Send packet prompts through stdin, and verify native argument handling on the actual host before relying on it. PowerShell rejects linked/reparse state-directory ancestry. A command pipeline must not substitute the last filter exit for the child exit.

p.PERMISSIONS: Unattended exec uses sandbox workspace-write and approval never. A read-only reviewer may request -s read-only. Normal read/search, shell, formatters, generators and exact tests are allowed within the packet. Do not bypass sandbox policy or replace necessary tools with an arbitrarily starved tool set. Non-routine external effects require existing parent authorization.

p.PACKET-FILE: Substantial instructions live in an ordinary packet file in the worker cwd or at an explicitly readable absolute path. The short pointer repeats quiet mode, exact packet path, visible artifacts, report and authority invariants. Every input must exist. Populate the copy-ready packet-template completely; unresolved placeholders are defects.

p.WRITE-SCOPE: Write only named product paths and the named report. Preserve prior changes. A needed expansion stops for a parent amendment; a worker cannot authorize it by mentioning it after the fact. Deliver ordinary visible unstaged files, never a patch-only copy, hidden cache or external-only result.

p.GIT-BOUNDARY: Read-only Git status, diff, log, show and blame are evidence. Workers never mutate the index, commit, push, merge, rebase, stash, reset, restore, checkout, create a private worktree or rewrite refs. Parent-owned preparation/integration is separate. Do not spawn further workers without explicit authorization.

p.REPORT-EARLY: Create the durable report skeleton after the first meaningful slice, mark unfinished checks PENDING and update before long gates. Give exact changed paths, evidence per criterion, commands with real exits and meaningful counts, decisions, scope breaches, blockers and remaining work. Report observed process status separately from advisory task verdict and parent acceptance. Screen TASK-DONE or PASS is never acceptance.

p.ORACLES: Choose targeted gates that actually decide the outcome, including failure cases when material. A filtered test command requires a nonzero relevant test count. An empty search needs a positive control when emptiness could be vacuous. Capture the real exit directly. Do not weaken, delete or broaden an oracle merely to obtain green output.

p.MUTATIONS: Mutation checks are reserved for suspicious or material false-green cases; they are not compulsory for every task. Run only the named temporary mutation within the authorized write scope, record why it tests the suspected defect and restore it. No compulsory broad suite follows decisive narrow gates unless a host requirement, new failure or unresolved concern justifies it.

p.PARENT-ACCEPTANCE: The parent compares actual changed paths to the packet and report, reads the full relevant diff/artifact, reproduces the decisive checks and classifies missing evidence. Issue accept, serialized repair, recommission remainder or reject. Integration/cleanup follows disposition, not worker self-report. A transport exit of zero proves only process completion.

p.REQUEST-NOT-IDENTITY: Configured gpt-6.1-sol and medium are requested settings. Record CLI version, argv and independently observed terminal model/effort metadata when available. A model self-report or requested alias alone does not verify effective identity or effort; absent metadata remains unverified. Fake-child coverage is never live execution evidence.

p.EXACT-IDENTITY: Pin each launch to explicit cwd and isolated home; retain the exact process handle/PID and CLI thread identifier when available. A correction preserves the same cwd/home/thread binding. Do not use ambiguous latest-session continuation. A fresh remainder packet is preferable when no reliable thread identity survives.

p.OBSERVE-NOT-RESTART: An observation-tool timeout does not mean the worker exited. Poll or inspect the exact original process handle, last meaningful event, visible artifacts and report. Do not restart or create a duplicate writer while that process remains alive. File mtime, log growth and a grep hit for TASK-DONE are neither completion nor a code verdict.

p.TERMINAL-STATES: Record actual exit/signal and provider/CLI error separately. Quota exhaustion, transport timeout, process crash, cancellation or a stalled final turn can leave useful work. Preserve cwd, diff, report, retained handles and unrun gates. No quota availability, subscription entitlement or reset success is guaranteed. Never copy account-specific state or token values into this package.

p.SERIALIZED-CORRECTIONS: Wait for verified real process exit before starting a correction writer. Inspect artifacts first, then amend the packet with named findings and verification tail. Resume only the explicit thread in the original cwd/home, or commission a fresh bounded remainder. Never blindly retransmit the whole task or spin retries against a known quota wall.

p.EXACT-STOP-CLEANUP: If stopping is necessary, stop only the exact marked process or identified child chain; never kill by executable name. Verify exit before cleanup. Remove a worker cwd only after disposition, preserved unique artifacts and durable findings; no live process or unclassified product artifact may remain.

p.PROVENANCE-REFERENCE: History and evidence limits: @spec://org.vibevm.world/codex-subagents/flows/codex-subagents/provenance#root. GLM practice supplies historical process lessons only; no retired subscription, GLM routing rule or host campaign is inherited.
